questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question:

  • Size of each record $= 3200$ bytes
  • Access time of $D = 10$ msecs
  • Data transfer rate of $D = 800 \times 10^3$ bytes/second
  • CPU time to process each record $= 3$ msecs

What is the elapsed time of $P$ if
questions.rawQuestionHtml:
A program $P$ reads and processes $1000$ consecutive records from a sequential file $F$ stored on device $D$ without using any file system facilities. Given the following

  • Size of each record $= 3200$ bytes
  • Access time of $D = 10$ msecs
  • Data transfer rate of $D = 800 \times 10^3$ bytes/second
  • CPU time to process each record $= 3$ msecs

What is the elapsed time of $P$ if

  1. $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ does not use buffering?

  2. $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ uses one buffer (i.e., it always reads ahead into the buffer)?

  3. records of $F$ are organized using a blocking factor of $2$ (i.e., each block on $D$ contains two records of $F$) and $P$ uses one buffer?
options: $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ does not use buffering?
$F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ uses one buffer (i.e., it always reads ahead into the buffer)?
records of $F$ are organized using a blocking factor of $2$ (i.e., each block on $D$ contains two records of $F$) and $P$ uses one buffer?

structuredOptions.label: A
structuredOptions.text: $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ does not use buffering?
structuredOptions.html: $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ does not use buffering?

structuredOptions.label: B
structuredOptions.text: $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ uses one buffer (i.e., it always reads ahead into the buffer)?
structuredOptions.html: $F$ contains unblocked records and $P$ uses one buffer (i.e., it always reads ahead into the buffer)?

structuredOptions.label: C
structuredOptions.text: records of $F$ are organized using a blocking factor of $2$ (i.e., each block on $D$ contains two records of $F$) and $P$ uses one buffer?
